explication: PokeTokenBar is a macOS menu-bar usage tracker wrapped in a Pokémon companion game. The main workflow is local coding-tool logs and official quota sources → usage aggregation → companion growth, rewards, and collection → menu-bar, popover, or desktop-pet presentation. The graph also preserves the documented shop, bag, settings, and Pokémon-data capabilities. Source excerpts and the index support the central wiring; some feature-level connections are documented by the README rather than inspected implementation.
